text:
I couldn't assign PAL-5866 to bay B-02, so I made no assignment.

I signed in, opened the Warehouse page, and selected PAL-5866 in the "Pallet to place" dropdown. The bays are drawn on a canvas with no DOM labels or bay elements, so I couldn't find B-02 on the map. Several canvas clicks left "Selected bay" at none, and coordinate-based clicks failed with an "Invalid mouse button" error. I did not click Assign pallet.

The remaining step is to click bay B-02 on the map and then press Assign pallet. This needs either a way to locate bays on the canvas or a bay list that the page doesn't currently expose.
